def transform(grid):
    # Fill the empty row between two same-color rectangular components with color 3.
    rows = len(grid)
    for r in range(rows):
        if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]) and r > 0 and r < rows-1:
            above = any(v != 0 for v in grid[r-1])
            below = any(v != 0 for v in grid[r+1])
            if above and below:
                grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
                grid[r] = [3] * len(grid[r])
                break
    return grid

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
